compact.description: Provider-native compaction confirmed by a structured cmux hook event. source compacts before the fork and requires the selected checkpoint to be the timeline tail; target compacts only the successor. Unsupported providers fail closed.

renameTarget.description: Title applied to the successor's Omha-owned cmux workspace after the fork.

renameSource.description: Title applied to the source surface (tab; workspace when Omha owns it) after the successor rename.
